_mode.contract: TEMPORARY Captain directive, 2026-10-21T06:10Z: until 2026-10-25, MiniMax M3.1 Flash is free, so all delegated work routes to minimax-code/minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash. This replaces the Codex-only mode of 2026-10-18, whose own contract said to re-measure quota-axi before reverting and not to assume recovery. Re-measured 2026-10-21T04:48Z: minimax general 5h 95% remaining, 7d 73%; codex five_hour 70%, weekly 82% (shared with Sol). THIS DIRECTIVE EXPIRES ON 2026-10-25 - on that date the routing falls back to the standing rules below unless the Captain renews it. A renewal must be a fresh measurement plus a fresh Captain word, never a silent carry-over.

temporary.reason: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is free until 2026-10-25; route delegated work to the free tier instead of the paid codex account.
temporary.renewal_rule: Re-measure quota-axi before each dispatch wave. If the MiniMax 5h window is materially depleted, drop this override early rather than letting it ride to its expiry on a dead window. On expiry the routing falls back to the standing rules and the fleet says so.

rules.when: The task requires genuinely difficult, high-ambiguity, architectural, or multi-component implementation.
rules.why: Temporary override in force until 2026-10-25 (see _mode): MiniMax M3.1 Flash is free, so the hard work goes there rather than onto the paid codex account. This rule used to send hard work to openai-codex/gpt-6-luna at high effort because Luna is the model that comfortably survives a 5-hour re-up cycle. That remains the standing preference once the temporary override expires.

rules.when: The task requires live news, current events, X/Twitter data, market sentiment, or web-connected research.
rules.why: Temporary override in force until 2026-10-25 (see _mode). Previously a Captain Luna6-only override with the rule that a missing tool capability is a disclosed blocker, never an automatic model fallback; that rule still holds - report the missing capability instead of silently swapping models.

rules.when: The task is routine day-to-day coding, bug fixing, test writing, refactoring, or feature implementation, including simple low-risk bounded work and browser evidence capture under a precise procedure.
rules.why: Temporary override in force until 2026-10-25 (see _mode). Previously bounded/routine work ran on openai-codex/gpt-6-luna at medium effort, with the rule never to select the retired MiniMax M2.5 / M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed families (retired 2026-10-19 for new users, 2026-11-18 outright). M3.1 Flash is not one of those retired families.

rules.when: A worker requests independent review of its own completed work, or a review gate must run without blocking the worker.
rules.why: Temporary override in force until 2026-10-25 (see _mode). The review rules that survive it: the reviewer is never the author, the reviewer runs as a fresh independent lane, and it stays async so it never blocks the worker.
